description: This file defines an interface named GSIMReadPlatformService that specifies methods for retrieving Group Savings Individual Monitoring Account data and containers from the system, based on various identifiers such as parent account number, GSIM ID, group ID, or account number.

classes.name: GSIMReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for reading Group Savings Individual Monitoring account data from the system.

methods.name: findGsimAccountByParentAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoringAccountData by parent account number.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountsByGSIMId
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM accounts using the GSIM ID.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountsByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM accounts associated with a specific group ID.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountContainerByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves containers of GSIM accounts for a particular group ID.

methods.name: findGsimAccountContainerbyGsimAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM account containers based on account number.

methods.name: findGsimAccountByGroupIdandAccountNo
methods.description: Retrieves GSIM account data by group ID and account number.

methods.name: findGsimAccountContainerbyGsimAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GSIM account containers by parent account ID.

methods.name: findGSIMAccountByGSIMId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific GSIM account by its ID.
